title: Web Media Live Public Client Parity
problem: The new web Media surface has initial fixture/live seams but still needs truthful live Public Client browse, detail, playback entry, and playback-state parity.
evidence: WMLP-010 opened the lane from WDRP-020 after inspecting current web Public Client seams and generated SDK playback methods.

WMLP-020 audited the committed generated TypeScript SDK, committed Public Client route inventory, and current web Public Client data-source seam; ROUTE_API_READINESS.md now records ready contracts plus the library-scoped item browse gap. npm --prefix web run test -- src/test/data-source-contracts.test.ts passed with 13 tests; npm --prefix web run check passed.

WMLP-030A added Public Media read-model boundaries and tests for detail sources/images plus library metadata/source readiness. npm --prefix web run test -- src/test/data-source-contracts.test.ts passed with 16 tests; npm --prefix web run check passed; npm --prefix web run build:budget passed.

WMLP-030 routed Media browse/detail/search/library through Public Media read models where contracts exist and explicit readiness gaps where they do not. npm --prefix web run test passed with 47 tests; npm --prefix web run check passed; npm --prefix web run build:budget passed.

WMLP-040 wired browser-ticket playback planning and native VideoPlayer media/subtitle rendering with no-token assertions. Browser heartbeat is split as a follow-on because BrowserPlaybackTicketResponse does not expose a playback session id. npm --prefix web run test, npm --prefix web run check, and npm --prefix web run build:budget passed.

WMLP-050 wired continue-watching plus playback-state progress/watched read-write contracts in the Public Media data source and home surface. npm --prefix web run test passed with 49 tests; npm --prefix web run check passed; npm --prefix web run build:budget passed.

WMLP-060 closed the lane after npm --prefix web run test, npm --prefix web run check, npm --prefix web run build:budget, npm --prefix web run tauri -- build, browser smoke for Media routes, JSON validation, and git diff --check passed.

continue_policy.notes: WMLP is closed. Return to WDRP-030 for Admin Operations reentry, or open a follow-on contract lane for browser playback session identity, library-scoped item browse, catalog sort/filter, or desktop native playback.
